About Specialties Approach {{PRIMARY_CTA_LABEL}}

Quiet care. Real progress.

Therapeutic support for adults navigating anxiety, relationships, and life transitions

I work with people who want practical, compassionate guidance. Sessions blend evidence-informed approaches with attuned listening so you can make steady change at your own pace.

{{PRIMARY_CTA_LABEL}}

Sessions by appointment in {{CITY}}, {{STATE}}. Confidentiality is upheld; see practice policies below.

What people say

"The sessions helped me feel more confident and less stuck. Practical tools I could use between appointments."

— A client in {{CITY}}

"Warm, steady, and thoughtful — I appreciated the clear structure and the real compassion."

— Recently completed program participant

How I can help

Reduce overwhelm

Tools to manage anxiety and regain daily rhythm — tailored to your goals.

Heal relational wounds

Work through attachment patterns and build clearer, healthier boundaries.

Move through transitions

Support during career change, loss, or major life shifts with grounded planning.

What working together looks like

  1. 1. Connect

    Phone consult to clarify needs and fit — free 15-minute intro.

  2. 2. Begin

    Initial intake session to set goals and establish a plan together.

  3. 3. Practice

    Therapeutic sessions with actionable strategies, check-ins, and reflections.

  4. 4. Transition

    Review progress and plan steps for continued growth or graduation from therapy.

Frequently asked

Do you accept insurance?

I am an out-of-network provider. I can provide a superbill you may submit to your insurer. Payment is due at the time of session.

How long is a typical session?

Standard sessions are 50 minutes. We can discuss longer or more frequent meetings depending on your needs.

Are sessions confidential?

Yes. I follow professional confidentiality standards. Exceptions include imminent risk of harm to self or others, or court-ordered disclosure.

Welcome Guide for New Clients

Practical first steps to get the most from therapy: preparing for your first session, simple grounding practices, and communication tips.

By signing up you consent to receive the guide. I will not share your information.

Ready to begin?

Schedule a free 15-minute consult to see if we’re a good fit.

.modal-close{border:0;background:none;position:absolute;right:20px;top:18px;font-size:1rem} @media (max-width:900px){ .hero-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;} .testimonials{grid-template-columns:1fr} .benefit-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr} .steps{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr} .nav-toggle{display:inline-block} .main-nav{display:none} document.getElementById('leadModal'); var close = modal && modal.querySelector('.modal-close'); var form = document.getElementById('leadForm'); var navToggle = document.querySelector('.nav-toggle'); var mainNav = document.querySelector('.main-nav'); function openModal(){ if(modal){ modal.setAttribute('aria-hidden','false'); document.body.style.overflow='hidden'; }} function closeModal(){ if(modal){ modal.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true'); document.body.style.overflow=''; }} if(lead) lead.addEventListener('click', openModal); if(close) close.addEventListener('click', closeModal); if(modal) modal.addEventListener('click', function(e){ if(e.target===modal) closeModal(); }); if(form){ form.addEventListener('submit', function(e){ e.preventDefault(); var email = form.email.value; form.querySelector('button').disabled = true; form.querySelector('button').innerText = 'Sending...'; // Simulate sending setTimeout(function(){ form.querySelector('button').innerText = 'Sent'; form.reset(); setTimeout(closeModal,900); }, 900); }); } if(navToggle){ navToggle.addEventListener('click', function(){ mainNav.classList.toggle('open'); }); } // Ensure
behavior accessible: close others when one opens var details = document.querySelectorAll('details'); details.forEach(function(d){ d.addEventListener('toggle', function(){ if(d.open){ details.forEach(function(other){ if(other!==d) other.open=false; }); } }); }); // Smooth scroll for internal links document.addEventListener('click', function(e){ var a = e.target.closest('a'); if(a && a.getAttribute('href') && a.getAttribute('href').startsWith('#')){ e.preventDefault(); var id = a.getAttribute('href').slice(1); var el = document.getElementById(id); if(el) el.scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth'}); } }); })();"} {"path":"assets/img/hero.svg","content":""} {"path":"assets/img/avatar.svg","content":""} {"path":"assets/img/pattern.svg","content":""} {"path":"robots.txt","content":"User-agent: * Disallow: Sitemap: /sitemap.xml "} {"path":"sitemap.xml","content":" https://www.example.com/ weekly https://www.example.com/about.html https://www.example.com/specialties.html https://www.example.com/approach.html https://www.example.com/fees.html https://www.example.com/faq.html https://www.example.com/book.html https://www.example.com/contact.html "} BUNDLE_END
